name: @heatcompass/heat-engine-spec
description: TypeScript types + fixture loaders for the heat-engine-spec contract.

scripts.sync-fixtures: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path');for (const f of ['wet-bulb.fixtures.csv','flag-mapping.fixtures.csv','refuge-break.fixtures.csv','verdict-promotion.fixtures.csv']) fs.copyFileSync('../../spec/tier1-foundation/'+f,'./fixtures/'+f);fs.mkdirSync('./fixtures/cascade-replay',{recursive:true});for (const f of fs.readdirSync('../../spec/tier1-foundation/cascade-replay').filter(n=>n.endsWith('.json'))) fs.copyFileSync('../../spec/tier1-foundation/cascade-replay/'+f,'./fixtures/cascade-replay/'+f);"
